title: Power of Attorney for Health Care

signers.label: Approving Justice
signers.note: Filled automatically at approval — not part of the intake handoff flow.

fields.label: Applicant Discordia
fields.prompt: What Discord email/account do you have on file?

fields.label: CID
fields.prompt: Use /cid in city. This will add your CID to your clipboard. Paste that in here please.

fields.label: Agent Name
fields.prompt: Who do you designate as your health care agent?

fields.label: Agent CID
fields.prompt: Use /cid in city. This will add your CID to your clipboard. Paste that in here please.

fields.label: Alternative Agent Name
fields.prompt: Who is your first alternative agent, if your primary agent is unavailable?

fields.label: Alternative Agent CID
fields.prompt: Use /cid in city. This will add your CID to your clipboard. Paste that in here please.

fields.label: Agent's Signature
fields.note: Collected from the agent directly, confirming they accept the role. Filled via the separate document hand-off/signature-routing system after the filer submits -- not asked during intake.

fields.label: Witness CID
fields.prompt: Use /cid in city. This will add your CID to your clipboard. Paste that in here please.

fields.label: Witness Signature
fields.note: Collected from the witness directly. Filled via the separate document hand-off/signature-routing system after the filer submits -- not asked during intake.

fields.label: Approving Justice
fields.note: Rendered in cursive. Filled in by the bot when a Supreme Court Justice approves the directive — never asked of the applicant.
